FEAT-2-S144.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contracts
FEAT-2-S144.description: Define and implement Pydantic models for specialty input and output contracts, including normalized NUCC code structure, confidence scores, and multi-specialty response format.

FEAT-2-S145.title: Expose Specialty Identification via FindCare Facade
FEAT-2-S145.description: Integrate specialty identification into the FindCare facade, ensuring user input flows through facade orchestration and returns structured NUCC mappings for downstream provider search.

FEAT-2-S146.title: Unit Tests for Specialty Mapping Logic
FEAT-2-S146.description: Create unit tests for regex extraction, vector matching, deduplication, and confidence scoring to validate correctness across common and edge-case specialty inputs.

FEAT-2-S147.title: Integrate NUCC Specialty Data Source
FEAT-2-S147.description: Ensure NUCC taxonomy data is properly loaded and accessible to the specialty service, including validation of code mappings and alignment with provider search taxonomy fallback.
